title: 第11章 拍卖第12章 试探
content_zh:
看到下方众人这般火热状态，齐泰脸上也露出了满意之色。
“好了，废话我也不再多说，现在我说一下这拍卖规则，两枚聚元丹分开拍卖，每一枚底价六万青玄币，每一次加价，不得少于一千青玄币！”
齐泰话音落下，那原本火热的拍卖厅，却一下子安静了下来。
六万青玄币，足以让诸多小家族望而却步。
“六万青玄币，希望大家给我林天雄一个面子，这一枚就不要争了！”
贵宾席中央位置，林家家主林天雄直接说道。
另外三家家族之人眉头都是一皱，但还是选择沉默。
天水城虽然号称四大家族，但实际上是一强三弱，林家的实力，远在另外三家之上！
甚至另外三家加起来，都未必是林家的对手。
那便是因为林家的老家主乃是大武师高手，而且还是三级大武师！
即使是另外三大家族，也不敢与林家争锋。
拍卖台上，齐泰眉头一皱，脸上露出不悦之色。
他身为拍卖师，自然希望拍卖的价格越高越好，可这林天雄一张口就让其他人不要竞争，可以说是坏了拍卖的规矩。
林天雄嘴角微微上扬，一脸傲意。
他自信，天水城中，没有人敢挑战林家的威严。
而事实也是如此，自从林天雄放下话来，没有人敢再往上加价。
毕竟，还有没有聚元丹，为此得罪林家属实不智。
苏辰心中不禁一阵火起。
这林天雄属实是有些霸道。
若是任凭大家竞争，看现在的态势，至少能多拍卖两三万青玄币。

“林家主出六万青玄币，还有没有更高的？”
“好，六万青玄币一次。”
“六万青玄币两次。”
“六万青玄币三次。”
“成交，恭喜林家主！”
一名黑云商会的侍女将其中一个药瓶递给了林天雄。
“多谢诸位，这第二枚聚元丹，我们林家便不再争了。”
林天雄哈哈一笑，直接带着林家之人起身离去。
齐泰强压住心中的火气，苍老的脸上依旧满是微笑：“好，现在拍卖第二枚聚元丹，与之前一样，六万枚青玄币起拍，每次加价，不得少于一千枚青玄币。”
“六万五千！”
“六万八千！”
“七万一千！”
content_en:
Seeing the enthusiastic state of the people below, Qitai also showed a look of satisfaction on his face.
"Okay, I won't say any more nonsense. Now let me tell you the rules of the auction. The two Juyuan Pills are auctioned separately. Each has a base price of 60,000 Qingxuan coins. Each increase in price must not be less than 1,000 Qingxuan coins!"
After Qi Tai finished speaking, the originally bustling auction hall suddenly became quiet.
Sixty thousand Qingxuan coins are enough to scare away many small families.
"Sixty thousand Qingxuan coins, I hope everyone will give me, Lin Tianxiong, some face. Don't fight for this one!"
In the center of the VIP table, Lin Tianxiong, the head of the Lin family, said directly.
The other three families frowned, but still chose to remain silent.
Although Tianshui City is known as the four major families, they are actually one strong and three weak. The strength of the Lin family is far superior to the other three!
Even the other three families combined may not be the opponents of the Lin family.
That's because the old head of the Lin family is a master martial artist, and a third-level martial artist at that!
Even the other three major families did not dare to compete with the Lin family.
On the auction stage, Qitai frowned, with a look of displeasure on his face.
As an auctioneer, he naturally hopes that the auction price will be as high as possible, but Lin Tianxiong just told others not to compete, which can be said to have broken the rules of the auction.
The corners of Lin Tianxiong's mouth raised slightly, with a look of pride on his face.
He was confident that no one in Tianshui City dared to challenge the majesty of the Lin family.
And the fact is that since Lin Tianxiong dropped his words, no one dared to increase the price.
After all, there is still Juyuan Dan, so it would be unwise to offend the Lin family for this.
Su Chen couldn't help but feel angry.
This Lin Tianxiong is really a bit domineering.
If everyone is allowed to compete, looking at the current situation, at least two to thirty thousand more Qingxuan coins can be auctioned.
"The head of the Lin family has offered 60,000 Qingxuan coins, is there anything higher?"
"Okay, sixty thousand Qingxuan coins once."
"Sixty thousand Qingxuan coins twice."
"Sixty thousand Qingxuan coins three times."
"The deal is done, congratulations to the Lin family!"
A maid from the Black Cloud Chamber of Commerce handed one of the medicine bottles to Lin Tianxiong.
"Thank you all, our Lin family will no longer fight for this second Yuan Ju Dan."
Lin Tianxiong laughed, got up and left with the Lin family members.
Qi Tai suppressed the anger in his heart, his old face still full of smile: "Okay, now the second Juyuan Dan is auctioned. As before, the starting price is 60,000 Qingxuan coins. Each time the price is increased, it must not be less than 1,000 Qingxuan coins."
"Sixty-five thousand!"
"Sixty-eight thousand!"
"Seventy-one thousand!"
